title: Asking For and Giving Advice
summary: Discussing habits and offering recommendations politely.
whyItMatters: Useful advice begins with the person's goal and offers a manageable option with a reason.

mentalModel.title: Understand before advising
mentalModel.content: Ask about the situation, goal, and difficulty before proposing a solution.

mentalModel.title: Offer and check
mentalModel.content: Give one suggestion, explain why it may help, and ask whether it feels realistic.

ruleBlocks.title: Ask focused questions
ruleBlocks.content: Use Was möchtest du ändern, Was ist schwierig, and Was hast du schon probiert.

ruleBlocks.title: Keep advice polite
ruleBlocks.content: Use Du könntest, Vielleicht hilft es, or An deiner Stelle würde ich.

ruleBlocks.title: React to advice clearly
ruleBlocks.content: Accept it, explain a concern, or ask for another option.

tables.title: Advice Conversation Toolkit
rows: Hast du noch eine andere Idee?

examples.de: Ich möchte mehr Sport machen. Was würdest du mir empfehlen?
examples.en: I want to exercise more. What would you recommend?

examples.de: Du könntest mit einer Freundin trainieren, weil das motivierender ist.
examples.en: You could train with a friend because that is more motivating.

examples.de: Das klingt gut, aber zweimal pro Woche ist für mich realistischer.
examples.en: That sounds good, but twice a week is more realistic for me.

commonMistakes.correct: Offer a realistic option unless a firm instruction is necessary.

commonMistakes.wrong: Give advice without asking about the goal.
commonMistakes.reason: The same solution does not fit everyone.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies routines, goals, and constraints.
Könnte and sollte express different strengths of advice.
